groups.activity: kill every Kuva Guardian and Kuva Jester
groups.meta: Kuva Flood is the same at levels 80-100
conditions: Kuva Survival spawns only the occasional Guardian or Jester. Run Siphons or Floods.
Guardians hold a Kesheg that makes them immune. Knock it away with the Operator's Void Sling, then kill them.
Kuva pays out whether or not you kill them, but skipping them skips the parts.
bonuses: Floods pay double Kuva and guarantee a Requiem Relic.
Astral Twilight, a common Siphon drop, is a good glaive stance.

disclosures.title: buying Kuva instead
disclosures.body: Direct Kuva farming is a poor use of time. Weekly vendor routes: Riven Slivers from Palladino in Iron Wake, Voidplume Pinions from Archimedean Yonta in the Chrysalith, Vitus Essence at the Arbitrations vendor.

disclosures.title: other Guardian sources
disclosures.body: Void Flood in Zariman with the Kuva Guardians contamination effect spawns pairs repeatedly. Nekros reportedly yielded about 3 parts per siphon in older threads.

rows.label: Orvius

conditions: Parts and Kuva are separate rolls: two blades but one disc.
